Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery

Released January 20, 2023 · 70 cards

StandardExpanded

Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on January 20, 2023. It has 70 cards. It includes 60 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

58 illustrators worked on Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (9), AKIRA EGAWA (4), Naoki Saito (2), Akira Komayama (1), Amelicart (1), aoki (1), Asako Ito (1), Atsushi Furusawa (1).
